desc:
Meet the Apothecary Rapid Deploy, a compact and versatile utility pouch designed for easy access and organization. Featuring a low-profile design, this pouch is built with MOLLE compatibility on the front, a Velcro rear panel, and secure top clips, allowing you to attach it to gear, bags, or vehicle setups with ease. Perfectly sized for on-the-go storage, it fits seamlessly in a backpack, vehicle, or larger bag. With multiple compartments, it’s ideal for storing tools, first aid essentials, gloves, batteries, and other everyday gear.

Whether you're looking for a rugged organizer for work, outdoor adventures, or emergency preparedness, the Apothecary Rapid Deploy by RÈBÈLs RÄIDÈRs is designed to keep your essentials secure and within reach.

Features

• Sling-Style Design for quick wear and easy access.
• Bungee Mag Retention keeps mags secure.
• Medical Pouch with internal elastic loops for organization.
• 1.5" x 6" Loop Panel for patches or identifiers.
• Removable Waist Belt for added stability.
• Top Clips & Rear Velcro for plate carrier conversion.
• Flexible Storage fits up to Two M4 mags (five with 3 cell placard), 2 pistol mags/flashlight & medical gear.
• Durable 500D Nylon for rugged reliability.
• Adjustable Shoulder Strap (~28"–55").
• Waist Strap expands up to ~36" (if you need it... bro).
• 9.0" (L) x 11.0" (W) x 2.0" (H)
• Weight: ~27 oz - If this is a concern, stop buying gear and hit the gym
• Chicken Nugget Rating: 160-200 Chicken Nuggets
• Made In Vietnam so it will love you long time
